Tools Don’t Make You an Engineer

27 Jan 2026

Kubernetes doesn’t make you an engineer. Neither does Terraform, AWS, or Docker.

Tools amplify thinking. They don’t replace it.

I’ve seen:

  • Over-engineered systems with no monitoring
  • Perfect pipelines deploying broken logic
  • “Best practices” applied blindly and failing badly

Engineering is about:

  • Trade-offs
  • Constraints
  • Failure modes
  • Operational reality

If you can’t explain why a tool exists in your system, you probably don’t need it.

Engineering starts before the tool choice.
